label: lr 1e-3, seed 0
caption: Display mapping, identical for every panel: the linear green plane is clamped to [0,1], multiplied by this scene's gain, clamped again, then passed through the sRGB transfer curve (12.92x for x <= 0.0031308, otherwise 1.055*x^(1/2.4) - 0.055) and quantised to 8-bit grey. The gain is min(max(0.8 / p99(reference), 1), 20). Source: RawGreenAdapter.to_display in scripts/viewer/export_to_viewer.py.
